title: Organic-looking brake assemblies debut on new Czinger 21C Spyder
summary: We first encountered Czinger’s direct-metal laser-sintering technology a decade ago, before founder Kevin Czinger had even started the car company—at the time, it was still Divergent 3D. Czinger even says the BrakeNode is easier to service than a conventional brake assembly.
